question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Jane Eyre, Bob gets Dracula, Claire gets Dune, Dave gets The Trial, Eve gets Emma, Fred gets Hamlet, and Gertrude gets Ivanhoe.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Eve and Bob swap books. Then, Dave and Bob swap books. Then, Eve and Claire swap books. Then, Fred and Claire swap books. Then, Fred and Bob swap books. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap books. Finally, Bob and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Gertrude has
Options:
(A) Jane Eyre
(B) Dracula
(C) Dune
(D) The Trial
(E) Emma
(F) Hamlet
(G) Ivanhoe
solution:
Each row lists the books held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: Jane Eyre | Dracula | Dune | The Trial | Emma | Hamlet | Ivanhoe
1. Eve and Bob swap: Jane Eyre | Emma | Dune | The Trial | Dracula | Hamlet | Ivanhoe
2. Dave and Bob swap: Jane Eyre | The Trial | Dune | Emma | Dracula | Hamlet | Ivanhoe
3. Eve and Claire swap: Jane Eyre | The Trial | Dracula | Emma | Dune | Hamlet | Ivanhoe
4. Fred and Claire swap: Jane Eyre | The Trial | Hamlet | Emma | Dune | Dracula | Ivanhoe
5. Fred and Bob swap: Jane Eyre | Dracula | Hamlet | Emma | Dune | The Trial | Ivanhoe
6. Gertrude and Alice swap: Ivanhoe | Dracula | Hamlet | Emma | Dune | The Trial | Jane Eyre
7. Bob and Alice swap: Dracula | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | Emma | Dune | The Trial | Jane Eyre
Gertrude has Jane Eyre, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
